sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT 
        "Đơn số" AS "order_id",
        DATE("Ngày HĐ") AS "order_date",
        "Giờ tạo đơn" AS "order_ts",
        "Barcode" AS "product_code",
        "Hàng hóa" AS "product_name_raw",
        "S.L" AS "qty",
        "ĐV" AS "unit",
        "Thành tiền (đ)" AS "amount",
        "Mã khách" AS "customer_id",
        "Khách hàng (tên)" AS "customer_name_raw",
        "Mã NV bán" AS "staff",
        "Nguồn" AS "channel",
        "Hình thức thanh toán" AS "payment",
        "_don_huy" AS "is_cancelled",
        "_tra" AS "is_returned",
        "SL (ĐV cơ bản)" AS "qty_basic"
    FROM "banhang_tonghop_banhang_all"
),
products AS (
    SELECT 
        "Mã H.hóa" AS "product_code",
        "Tên hàng hóa" AS "product_name",
        "Nhóm hàng" AS "product_group"
    FROM "banhang_tonghop_2025_banhang_hanghoa"
),
customers AS (
    SELECT 
        "Mã KH mua" AS "customer_id",
        "Khách hàng mua" AS "customer_name"
    FROM "banhang_tonghop_2025_banhang_khachhang"
)
SELECT 
    s."order_id",
    s."order_date",
    s."order_ts",
    COALESCE(p."product_code", s."product_code") AS "product_code",
    p."product_group",
    COALESCE(p."product_name", s."product_name_raw") AS "product_name",
    s."qty",
    s."unit",
    s."amount",
    s."customer_id",
    CASE 
        WHEN s."customer_id" IS NOT NULL THEN c."customer_name"
        ELSE CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(s."customer_name_raw")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'kl', 'khách lẻ', 'lẻ', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL
            ELSE s."customer_name_raw"
        END
    END AS "customer_name",
    s."staff",
    s."channel",
    s."payment",
    s."is_cancelled",
    s."is_returned",
    'item' AS "line_kind"
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN products p ON s."product_code" = p."product_code"
LEFT JOIN customers c ON s."customer_id" = c."customer_id"
